title: Pratelan beksa wireng Arjunasasra: prang tandhing kaliyan Bambang Sumantri
comment: Menceritakan tari perang Arjunasasra melawan Bambang Sumantri dengan diiringi gamelan. Awal teks: Pratelan beksa wireng Arjunasasra, prang tandhing kaliyan Bambang Sumantri, beksanipun kembar sami alusan ...
